decision_rules.rule: Use recovery mode immediately when scripts, aliases, Vite settings, or governance appear damaged.
Do not continue feature work until damage is repaired or explicitly waived.
When uncertain, preserve existing behavior and ask for clarification only if the ambiguity blocks a safe edit.
Do not simplify configuration, tooling, or governance merely because it appears verbose.

Prefer the smallest non-destructive fix for path, case, alias, and entrypoint errors. Do not delete folders to resolve a wiring problem unless the folder is proven unused and the removal is explicitly requested or test-verified.

boundary_guidance.rule: Keep governance updates separate from feature changes unless the user explicitly asks to merge them.
Prefer updating the smallest number of files that can keep the mode consistent.
Do not introduce new top-level structure when existing mode files can carry the change.

validation_guidance.rule: Validate XML well-formedness for supporting files.
Verify the mode slug remains unique in .roomodes.
Confirm the supporting directory contains the mode’s workflow and guardrail files.
